compiler.validation: Session.call_with_provider and native provider registry execute typed calls in one retained consumer session

evidence.summary: A consumer session performed an admitted provider_call without a subprocess or JSON semantic adapter between the consumer and provider.
The same generic runtime boundary admitted a different provider implementation and retained typed composition.

reproduction.instructions: Run the provider admission probe and compare its single native consumer session/provider_call path with the retained external CLI wrappers.

summary: The original every-invocation subprocess/JSON limitation is no longer true for the native development stack: one consumer session admits providers and invokes typed interfaces directly. External compatibility CLIs and mncs-store remain separate migration surfaces.

workaround.description: Compatibility subprocess/JSON entrypoints remain for external callers and mncs-store until that consumer is independently migrated.
